correctness.rationale: For all n>=2 the source plane-partition incidence criteria imply that F has every codimension-one face and itself is excluded. The ordered x,y matching is acyclic and its only unmatched face is F without x. Since x,y lie in F, matches cannot cross the induced boundary; an acyclic matching of every outside face yields elementary simplicial collapse onto the sphere. The half-turn swaps x,y and reverses n-1 significant edges, giving exactly 1+floor((n-1)/2) transpositions and the stated integral orientation. Independent finite verification executed exact collapses for n=2,3,4 and Lefschetz traces.

value.rationale: The induced canonical invariant sphere spine, actual simplicial collapse and 4-periodic integral orientation action refine a natural infinite family where only nonequivariant homotopy type was determined. The quotient rational top homology depends on this character, cannot be recovered from sphere rank, and motivates symmetry-sensitive topology for perfect matchings of hexagonal tilings. This is not a mere parameter substitution or table recomputation.
